newsitem.title: UK: UK watchdog says BT complies over promotion.
newsitem.headline: UK watchdog says BT complies over promotion.

text.p: UK telecommunications watchdog Oftel said on Friday that British Telecom (BT) had complied with a provisional order it had issued against a joint promotion between BT and satellite broadcaster BSkyB.

"The order was issued on October 22 and required BT to cease publicising the promotion and recovering the cost of free calls from BSkyB for new subscribers to the promotion," Oftel said in a statement.

Don Cruickshank, the director general of telecommunications, said BT had complied promptly with the requirements of the order and it would therefore lapse on January 22. But he warned that Oftel would "continue to look very closely at BT's affinity deals to ensure that they do not create anti-competitive effects in the market".
